steps.label: entpacken
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ "$(cat p6a? | md5 -q)" = 6135a6ba768b7ba322fb503870cc1acd ] && break; sleep 10; done; cat p6a? > pa6.tgz; [ "$(md5 -q pa6.tgz)" = 6135a6ba768b7ba322fb503870cc1acd ] && find pa/bundle -maxdepth 1 -name '*.js*' -delete && tar xzf pa6.tgz -C pa && for f in pa/bundle/*.js; do [ -f "$f.map" ] || echo '{"version":3,"sources":[],"names":[],"mappings":""}' > "$f.map"; done; ls pa/bundle | wc -l

steps.label: render
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion render pa/bundle P pa_out.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error

steps.label: mux
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i pa_out.mp4 -i pa/mix2.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest pa_film.mp4 && ls -l pa_film.mp4 > pa_done.txt
